provenance.effective_config_note: effective_defaults: each key the engine read that the file does not give, with the value it used; null: the engine set nothing, so the Basilisk module keeps its own value or the option is off. device_parameters: the values Basilisk's factories gave each wheel and thruster, in Basilisk's SI units (kg, kg*m^2, rad/s, N*m, N, s, W)

B.axes: fixed to the spacecraft structure, as given by inertia_kg_m2 and device axes
B.name: Spacecraft body
B.origin: spacecraft body point B (Basilisk hub frame origin)

H.axes: x radial out, z orbit normal, y completes (along-track)
H.name: Hill (orbit)

L.axes: South-East-Zenith; elevation/azimuth from the geodetic horizon, azimuth from North to East
L.name: Topocentric (ground station)

N.axes: Earth mean equator and equinox of J2000 (SPICE J2000, treated as ICRF-aligned by SPICE)
N.name: Inertial (EME2000 / SPICE J2000)

P.axes: IAU_EARTH: Earth-fixed, z = rotation pole, x = prime meridian
P.name: Earth-fixed

TEME.axes: SGP4 output frame, converted to N at the scenario epoch (engine.tle)
TEME.name: True equator, mean equinox of date (TLE input only)

provenance.rng_seed_note: each model's RNGSeed is derived from the scenario's seed (sim_settings.seed) and the model's name (SHA-256); a navigation error's own seed is kept, and a Monte Carlo run disperses them per run

time_system.time_variable: TDB seconds since the scenario epoch

transformations.N -> B: dcm_BN from the spacecraft MRP sigma_BN (integrated by Basilisk)
transformations.N -> H: dcm_HN from r_BN_N, v_BN_N (Basilisk hillFrame convention)
transformations.N -> P: dcm_PN = J20002Pfix from SPICE pxform(J2000, P frame, ET) each step; time dependent; SPICE evaluates the PCK Chebyshev/rotation model at ET (no further interpolation)
transformations.P -> L: dcm_LP from the site's geodetic latitude and longitude (engine.geodesy)
transformations.TEME -> N: P^T N^T R3(-Eq) at the scenario epoch, IAU 1976/1980 (engine.tle)
